title: NHL 22 - Sony PlayStation 5 EA Sports PS5 Frostbite
descriptionText: The product is NHL 22 for the Sony PlayStation 5, developed by EA Sports using their Frostbite engine. This sports game falls under the hockey sub-genre and is suitable for players aged 10 and older. Published by Electronic Arts, NHL 22 promises to deliver an immersive and realistic gaming experience for fans of ice hockey, showcasing the latest technology and gameplay innovations on the next-generation console.
